Chandrika Reddy vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 29
February, 2020
Author: J. Uma Devi

entities.text: Chandrika Reddy vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: J.Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J.Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.7708 of 2019
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/ A-3, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.414 of 2019 of Pedakakani Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 353, 272, 273, 420 r/w 34 I.P.C and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 62 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that batch of Criminal Petitions filed to quash the proceedings registered for the offences under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act were allowed by this Court vide order dated 27.08.2018, in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in Crime No.414 of 2019 of Pedakakani Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 353, 272, 273, 420 r/w 34 I.P.C and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 62 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of criminal petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in Crime No.414 of 2019 of Pedakakani Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 353, 272, 273, 420 r/w 34 I.P.C and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 62 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 against the petitioner/A-3.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
J. UMA DEVI, J Dated 29.02.2020 KA Chandrika Reddy vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 29 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35151233/
